name: yt-media-feed-helper
description: Read-only tracking of YouTube creators and Steam games: a channel catalog with multi-dimensional categories, reports with cited sources, diagnostic hooks and mutation guards.

workspace_dir.title: Workspace
workspace_dir.description: Directory for catalog/, reports/, logs/. Empty = the project directory.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_client_id.description: Client ID of a Desktop app OAuth client. The YTFEED_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID environment variable takes precedence.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_client_secret.description: Client secret (stored in the system keychain). The YTFEED_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable takes precedence.

google_client_secret_path.title: Google OAuth client secret — JSON file (alternative)
google_client_secret_path.description: Used only when client ID + secret are not set. Keep it outside the repository. The YTFEED_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE variable takes precedence.

steam_api_key.title: Steam Web API key (optional)
steam_api_key.description: Reserved — not required in v1 (public endpoints are used). The YTFEED_STEAM_API_KEY variable takes precedence.

mock_mode.title: Mock mode
mock_mode.description: Use fixtures instead of the real APIs (demo/tests, no Google Cloud needed).

report_budget_units.title: Report quota budget (units)
report_budget_units.description: Permanently raised default report budget (empty = 2000). The only source of a higher budget without a permission prompt; catalog/config.yaml can only lower it.

strict_deps.title: Install dependencies with hashes
strict_deps.description: true = launch.py install uses pip --require-hashes with requirements.hashes.txt (Windows x64 / Python 3.15 only).
